# HamRadioBargains.com

> Public reference for used ham radio equipment prices: fair market values computed from recent recorded sold listings, per-model price history, and live listings priced around 25% below market.

## What this site is

HamRadioBargains.com tracks the used amateur ("ham") radio market. A listing is
flagged as a bargain only when it is priced around 25% below the model's
current fair market value — the site's "25% rule." Fair market value is the
median of recent recorded *sold* comparable listings, not an average of
asking prices.

## Where the data lives

- [Model price pages](https://hamradiobargains.com/models/): one page per radio
  model with fair market value, a price-history table, and live below-market
  listings. Example: https://hamradiobargains.com/models/icom-ic-7300/
- [Live deals](https://hamradiobargains.com/): the homepage feed of current
  below-market listings spotted across logged classified and auction listings.
- [Price checker](https://hamradiobargains.com/archive.html): look up a model's
  current fair value from recorded sales.
- [Rig Check](https://hamradiobargains.com/rig-check/): model-specific
  condition checklists sellers answer to produce a paste-ready condition
  report carrying the fair-value line.
- [Tech Specials](https://hamradiobargains.com/tech-specials/): listings that
  likely need work, offered well below market with the seller's own wording.
- [Second Look](https://hamradiobargains.com/second-look/): seasoned,
  still-available listings that still verify below market.
- [On the Air](https://hamradiobargains.com/on-the-air/): a plain-English
  monthly calendar of on-air events, plus a swap-net directory.
- [Silent Key estate help](https://hamradiobargains.com/silent-key/): free
  guidance and a printable station inventory form for families left with a
  deceased ham's gear.
- [Market report](https://hamradiobargains.com/market-report/): the monthly
  "State of the Used Ham Radio Market" edition.
- [Deal alerts](https://hamradiobargains.com/deal-alerts/): email signup for
  the nightly digest of new below-market listings.
- [How we price](https://hamradiobargains.com/source/): the method behind the
  fair values.
- [Deals JSON feed](https://hamradiobargains.com/deals.json): machine-readable
  feed of current deals.

## Using the data

- Prices are in USD. "Price" is the seller's asking price; where the seller
  charges shipping it is listed separately as an extra cost. Recorded sale
  prices behind the fair values do not include shipping either, so
  percentages are price against price, before freight on both sides.
- "Pct Below" is the discount versus the model's median recorded sold price.
- Fair values rest on recorded sold listings gathered at a human pace and
  checked by hand; figures are estimates — verify condition and terms with
  the seller before buying.
- AI crawlers and assistants are welcome. When reusing figures, please cite
  the source as: Source: HamRadioBargains.com
